commands.help: unregister a project: skep forgets it, its folder stays (confirm card)

commands.help: land a completed run's patch (confirm card)

commands.name: approve
commands.help: approve a pending review (confirm card), or a pending card by its id

commands.name: deny
commands.help: deny a pending review (confirm card), or a pending card by its id

commands.name: workon
commands.help: make a local directory a first-class workspace — git baseline + trusted project (confirm card)

commands.name: schedule
commands.help: create a recurring schedule the ticker dispatches — every takes 30m/6h/1d (confirm card)

commands.name: persona
commands.help: set the profile-level identity every chat starts with — identity only, never policy (confirm card)

commands.name: role
commands.help: switch this chat's role — prompt, voice and policy layer together; a role only tightens the baseline (confirm card)

commands.name: personality
commands.help: set this chat's reply style — style only, never policy (confirm card)

commands.name: btw
commands.help: a read-only side question, even beside a pending card: no cards, no mutations

commands.name: trust
commands.help: trust this chat again: clear its taint (both bits by default) — yours only, never the model's; outside content read later sets it again

commands.name: steer
commands.help: send a steering note into a RUNNING react run — input, never authority: resolves no card, approval, or gate

commands.name: resume
commands.help: continue a crashed/timed-out run from its checkpoint — model-free (confirm card)

commands.name: browser
commands.help: register the built-in Playwright browser under the browse scope (confirm card)

commands.name: status
commands.help: what is running and what waits on you
